title: Unpaid request returns 402 with payment requirements

input.scenario: Request the paid resource with no PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. No chain or facilitator interaction is needed.

steps.description: Plain request to the paid resource, no payment header.

expectedBehavior: The server responds with HTTP 402 and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. The header is base64-encoded JSON that decodes to a PaymentRequired object with x402Version 2, a resource with a url, and at least one entry in accepts. The paid content is not returned.

assertions.name: PAYMENT-REQUIRED
assertions.description: PAYMENT-REQUIRED decodes to a valid V2 PaymentRequired object (x402Version 2, resource.url, non-empty accepts, atomic-unit amounts, CAIP-2 networks).

assertions.name: PAYMENT-RESPONSE
assertions.description: No settlement receipt is sent for an unpaid request.
The paid content is not in the response body.
